title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
summary: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe runs on Switch 2 with a free update that Nintendo released on September 2, 2026, so there is no paid upgrade pack. According to Nintendo, the update improves image quality on the Switch 2 screen and on high-resolution TVs, shortens loading times and raises local multiplayer on one console to 8 players (each player needs their own controller). It also adds CameraPlay for 2-4 player races, locally or online, if you have a compatible USB-C camera. Nintendo has not published resolution or frame rate figures for the update. The install is 11.3 GB, and the Switch 1 cartridge holds the full game and works in a Switch 2.
